name: Raspberry Vinegar No. 2
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: ripe raspberries, mashed
ingredients.originalText: a quart of ripe raspberries, mashed

ingredients.name: good cider vinegar
ingredients.originalText: a quart of good cider vinegar

instructions.text: Turn over a quart of ripe raspberries, mashed, a quart of good cider vinegar
Add one pound of white sugar
Let stand in the sun four hours
Strain it and squeeze out the juice
Put in a pint of good brandy
Seal it up in bottles, air-tight
Lay them on their sides in the cellar

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Turn over a quart of ripe raspberries, mashed, a quart of good cider vinegar
2. Add one pound of white sugar
3. Mix well
4. Let stand in the sun four hours
5. Strain it and squeeze out the juice
6. Put in a pint of good brandy
7. Seal it up in bottles, air-tight
8. Lay them on their sides in the cellar
9. Cover them with sawdust
